title: ChestMarket
description: Simple item-based chest shops with native holograms and GUI management.
body:
# ChestMarket
ChestMarket is a lightweight and intuitive plugin allowing players to create item trading shops using simple chests. Designed for ease of use and performance, it is ideal for Survival, Faction, or Semi-RP servers that want an economy based on item exchange without relying on complex virtual currency.

## Key Features
- Simple Item Trading : Exchange one item for another (e.g., 1 Diamond for 32 Dirt). No virtual currency required.
- Native Holograms : Automatically displays the selling item and its price above the chest. No external dependencies (like DecentHolograms or HolographicDisplays) are needed.
- Intuitive GUI : Manage your shops and view your sales through a clean and polished menu ( /cm shops ).
- Quick Creation : Create a shop in just a few clicks. Select the item to sell, then the price, and click on a chest.
- Admin & Test Mode : Administrators can use "External" mode to test shops as a regular player or moderate existing ones.
- Built-in Protection : Shops are protected against theft and destruction by other players.
- Customizable : All messages and the plugin prefix are configurable.
## Commands
- /cm create : Enables creation mode. Click a chest to set up your shop.
- /cm remove : Enables removal mode. Click one of your shops to remove it.
- /cm shops : Opens a menu listing all your active shops with their sales statistics.
- /cm external : (Admin) Toggles external mode to interact with your own shops as a customer.
## Permissions
- chestmarket.create : Allows shop creation (Default: OP).
- chestmarket.remove : Allows shop removal (Default: OP).
- chestmarket.admin : Grants access to admin commands and external mode (Default: OP).
## Installation
1. Download the .jar file.
2. Drop it into your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. The config.yml file will be automatically generated for you to adjust settings as needed.
